stem.text: A cylindrical iceberg of height $H$ floats in sea water. The top of the iceberg is at height $h$ above the surface of the water.

stem.alt: Diagram of a cylindrical iceberg floating in sea water, with labels h, H, iceberg and sea water.

stem.text: The density of ice is $\rho_\text{i}$ and the density of sea water is $\rho_\text{w}$.
What is the height $h$ of the iceberg above the sea water?
